Priya: opening the migration window now, quiesce at 02:00 UTC. small index population on orders.metadata, aiming for no customer impact.
Marco: acknowledge. I'll pin the canary to v3 and watch lock metrics.
deploy-bot: deploy started: migration/index-pop-2026-03 -> canary
Tess: plan: create concurrent shadow index, populate with batch-workers, then atomic swap. keep batch=200 to start.
Nina: add per-job timeout and a job watchdog. if any job fails 3x in a row, stop and rollback.
Priya: set abort conditions: any lock_wait > 20s or replication lag > 2m. @deploy-bot add escape-hatch flag.
deploy-bot: escape-hatch enabled: indexpop-escape=true
Priya: launching initial run: `./index_pop --table=orders.metadata --batch=200 --workers=3`
Marco: seeing steady progress: 200 rows / batch, ~0.6s/row. no lock spikes yet.
Tess: HOLD  worker 2 timed out and retried, queue depth rising. pausing further batches.
deploy-bot: rollback triggered: migration/index-pop-2026-03 -> previous-stable
Priya: tally: 3,400/24,000 rows processed. collecting logs and enabling additional instrumentation.
Nina: next steps: add exponential backoff, tighten watchdog, and run a dry-run on staging tomorrow. I'll update the release notes to reflect the abort.
Priya: thanks team  reschedule for Fri 02:00 UTC after fixes. please ack. :thumbsup:
